criteria.defer_to_prepare: Leave requiredness open in the readiness layer: any type without a stored version reads as unresolved, and the Standard drafting turn later records which types the verified route justified, produces those, and marks the declined ones not required with its reason.
criteria.evidence_keyword: Decide requiredness with deterministic keyword rules over verified check data, each citing its source: form values required exactly when employer questions exist; email subject and body required exactly when the route destination names an email address; CV and cover letter required exactly when a sourced requirement statement or attachment question names them; all other types not required with a stated reason; an unresolved route leaves every type unresolved.
criteria.fixed_kind_map: Assign required types from the route kind alone: a direct application route always needs CV, cover letter and form values, while referral and recruiter routes always need email subject, email body and CV; other judgments map to unresolved or not required.

instructions: You are advising a design decision for a job-application preparation app. Read the context and facts, then select the readiness-mapping option that best satisfies the stated acceptance gates. Prefer the option that keeps every required/not-required label traceable to verified check evidence, avoids fabricating demands the vacancy never stated, and stays implementable as deterministic code without a model call at read time.

state.context: Step 6 of the app prepares application materials for one checked vacancy. A prior check stage verified how to apply and stored a route record plus the employer's actual questions and sourced requirement statements. The readiness layer must now label each artifact type as ready, held, not required, or unresolved before any drafting happens. Ready means a current stored version exists; held means required but blocked on missing answers; not required means positively ruled out; unresolved means requiredness cannot be determined yet. The open question is which rule should decide requiredness for a verified application route.

facts.formValuesRule: derived at read time from saved answers; never stored
gates: A4: unused type marked not required, not fabricated
P02: materials the vacancy actually calls for; no universal checklist
routeValidation: application_route judgment requires direct|referral|recruiter kind plus non-empty destinationText

state.question: Which requiredness rule should the deterministic readiness layer apply for artifact types on a verified application route?
